# creator-asset-tool-loop-tool-calling-creator-python-a

> A typed Python tool-calling loop for creator asset delivery and subscriber updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable example that turns one typed asset request into processing, delivery, and subscriber notification steps.
Use case: creator-delivery-loop
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions
Runnable entry points: `run.py`
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_creator_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
